author: Alejandro Oroncoy
description: Connects university systems to AI assistants from the student's own account: courses, assignments, due dates, grades, instructor feedback, announcements and course materials. Uses the student's own SSO session, so no institutional API key is needed. Blackboard Learn today (UPC, Peru); more LMS connectors on the way.

localizations.description: Conecta los sistemas de tu universidad con tu asistente de IA desde tu propia cuenta: cursos, tareas, fechas de entrega, notas, feedback del profesor, anuncios y materiales. Usa tu sesión SSO, así que no hace falta ninguna clave de API de la institución. Hoy Blackboard Learn (UPC, Perú); vienen más conectores.
localizations.name: Campus

name: Campus

tools.description: Get the currently authenticated UPC student info
tools.name: blackboard_whoami

tools.description: List all enrolled courses for the current student
tools.name: blackboard_list_courses

tools.description: Get details of a specific course by its Blackboard ID (e.g. _529580_1)
tools.name: blackboard_get_course

tools.description: List content items inside a course or folder. Use parentId to navigate into subfolders.

parentId.description: Parent folder content ID (omit for root level)

tools.name: blackboard_list_contents

tools.description: List recent announcements for a course
tools.name: blackboard_list_announcements

tools.description: Instructors and classmates of a course. Use it to resolve an internal user id into a person's name. Pass search to look up one person and get their contact details.

search.description: Name of one person in the course

tools.name: blackboard_list_people

tools.description: List assignments and tasks in a course with due dates, scores and submission status
tools.name: blackboard_list_assignments

tools.description: List submission attempts for a specific assignment (gradebook column)
tools.name: blackboard_list_attempts

tools.description: Get all grades for the current student in a course
tools.name: blackboard_get_grades

tools.description: Download a file from a course content item and save it to disk. attachmentId can be a Blackboard attachment ID (for x-bb-file) or a full bbcswebdav URL (for x-bb-document embedded files). Saves to outputDir (default: current working directory).

attachmentId.description: Attachment ID from blackboard_list_attachments, or a full bbcswebdav URL for embedded files

filename.description: Filename to save as (e.g. displayName from blackboard_list_attachments). Falls back to Content-Disposition header.

outputDir.description: Directory to save the file (default: current working directory)

tools.name: blackboard_download_attachment

tools.description: List file attachments for a course content item. Works for x-bb-file and files embedded in document or assignment HTML. Audio and video are additionally returned as MCP resource_link blocks so capable clients can process them directly; attachment metadata remains available as a download fallback.
tools.name: blackboard_list_attachments

tools.description: Download a file directly from a Blackboard bbcswebdav URL and save it to disk. Saves to outputDir (default: current working directory).

filename.description: Filename to save as (e.g. displayName from blackboard_list_attachments)

outputDir.description: Directory to save the file (default: current working directory)

url.description: Direct file URL from bbcswebdav (downloadUrl from blackboard_list_attachments)

tools.name: blackboard_download_file_url

tools.description: Upload a local file (image, PDF, doc, etc.) to Blackboard and get back a fileUploadId. This only uploads the file — it does NOT attach it to an attempt yet. Pass the returned fileUploadId(s) into blackboard_save_attempt_draft or blackboard_submit_attempt via fileUploadIds.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload

tools.name: blackboard_upload_attempt_file

tools.description: Save progress on an assignment attempt WITHOUT submitting it — text, attached files, or both. The attempt stays open (status InProgress) so the student can keep editing it later. This does NOT send it to the instructor for grading — use blackboard_submit_attempt for that, and always confirm with the user before calling that one.

fileUploadIds.description: fileUploadId(s) from blackboard_upload_attempt_file to attach to this draft

tools.name: blackboard_save_attempt_draft

tools.description: Submit (finalize) an assignment attempt for grading — text, attached files, or both. ALWAYS confirm with the user before submitting, showing exactly what will be sent. Once submitted the instructor can grade it; use blackboard_save_attempt_draft instead if the student just wants to save progress without sending it yet.

fileUploadIds.description: fileUploadId(s) from blackboard_upload_attempt_file to attach to this submission

tools.name: blackboard_submit_attempt

tools.description: Get professor feedback and scores for all assignments in a course. For each graded submission, shows score, instructor comments, and any feedback files attached by the professor.
tools.name: blackboard_get_assignment_feedback

tools.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Download a feedback file that a professor attached to a graded attempt. Use the fileId from blackboard_get_assignment_feedback → attempt.feedbackFiles. The download endpoint may not be available on all Blackboard versions.

filename.description: Filename to save as (defaults to the name from feedbackFiles)

outputDir.description: Directory to save the file (default: current working directory)

tools.name: blackboard_download_feedback_file

tools.description: Make a raw REST API call to Blackboard Learn. Use for any endpoint not covered by other tools.
tools.name: blackboard_raw_api
